runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text: It applies after 180 days. M-25-22 covers any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after the memorandum was issued. The same 180-day date applies to any option to renew or extend the period of performance that is exercised on an existing contract.
